purpose: Separate public corporate surface, operational intelligence portal, and executive operating system versioning so legacy V-number lineage does not imply product-release equivalence.

public_partner_surface.role: Public corporate and strategic-partnership surface only
public_partner_surface.notes: Current public site may describe capabilities and partnership model but must not present unapproved live intelligence as validated Projection.

design_lineage: V666 visual system may be selectively inherited
operational_intelligence_portal.role: Governed consumer of approved Projection Registry outputs
operational_intelligence_portal.release_rule: Do not use V502 or V666 as the public product release identifier after Portal Release-001 adoption.

executive_operating_system.role: Founder/executive operational consumer of registries, events, audit and governed Projection
executive_operating_system.required_input: Approved governed Projection plus executive registries/events

versioning_policy.non_promotable_fixture_rule: Dry-run fixtures may validate plumbing but may not create a live approved Projection.
